name: The Last Shift's Tokens
description: Nine brass shift-tokens on a loop of wire, each stamped with a man's number and scratched on the back with his name, green with forty years of calamine: the last shift of the Crown Drift, taken off the deep board. The ninth, the captain's, is rubbed bright from being counted.

name: The Drift-Captain's Last Entry
description: A torn leaf from the Crown Drift's day-book, in Abel Rowse's hand: the last shift's names, the hour they went down, and nothing after.

name: A Schedule of Heron Eggs
description: A Tallymen's printed schedule for a tax on herons' eggs taken at the dead tower above Sedgehithe, a farthing the egg, with the clerk's own column for eggs counted left blank and, under it in pencil, 'NOT ONE'.

name: The Barrow Register
description: The Struck Barrow's register: forty years of the Receiver's fair hand, a number a line, four thousand and eleven of them, and against each the date and the debt. No names. On the last page, in the same hand, a twelfth line nobody received.

name: The Copyists' List
description: A quire of names copied out of the Struck Barrow's register by the Quiet Hands' resurrection men, each priced for sale in the Undercroft with the dead man's age and trade.
